commit.message:
Honor system proxy settings for standalone web search (#47142)

## Why

Standalone web search used a default HTTP client, bypassing the configured system proxy route when `respect_system_proxy` was enabled.

## What changed

Pass the configured `HttpClientFactory` to the web search tool and create its client asynchronously for the provider's search URL using the API route policy. Export and reuse `SEARCH_ENDPOINT` so route selection and search requests use the same endpoint.

## Testing

Add an isolated regression test with environment proxies removed and a mock system proxy. Verify that standalone web search reaches the proxy and returns its result in the follow-up model request.

GitOrigin-RevId: 3b64803a777b9d1eb0ccf694e06658b0fd562129

Prevent horizontal transcript selection from triggering autoscroll (#47137)

## Why

Dragging horizontally along the top or bottom transcript row could trigger autoscroll, moving the text under the pointer while selecting it.

## What changed

Require vertical pointer movement from the initial press row before selection autoscroll can begin. Remember that movement so a vertical drag can return to its starting edge and still autoscroll, and preserve the original pointer row across wheel scrolling.

## Testing

Extend regression tests and snapshots for horizontal selection at both edges, stable selected text across repeated ticks, wheel scrolling before the first drag, and autoscroll after a vertical drag returns to its starting edge.

GitOrigin-RevId: e13f3a80adbead1eecbeb281301667c8e12e1541

Support caller-provided MITM CAs in the network proxy (#47132)

## What changed

- Add optional `network.mitm_ca` configuration with `certificate_file` and
  `private_key_file` for trusted proxy configuration. Require MITM to be enabled
  and retain the generated CA when no external CA is configured.
- Validate absolute paths, regular files, file sizes, certificate/key matching,
  and Unix private-key permissions. Reject symlinks on Unix, private keys embedded
  in certificate files, and external private keys on non-Unix platforms.
- Store derived external-CA trust bundles in the proxy artifact directory,
  include only certificates, and skip inherited generated bundles to avoid
  retaining stale roots.
- Preserve MITM for external CAs when disabling credential brokerage. Reject
  external CA configuration for remote execution, even when the proxy is disabled,
  and reject unknown fields in `NetworkProxyConfig`.
- Default the upstream request version adapter to HTTP/1.1 and remove the request
  URI from upstream request failure context.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for external CA configuration, mismatched keys, embedded
private keys, non-Unix rejection, trust-bundle placement and contents, stale-root
exclusion, credential-broker toggling, and remote configuration rejection.

GitOrigin-RevId: cb209295c19fbe53a9fa0194f11ff06acccabef6

Remove the `ultrafast` service tier from `gpt-5.6-sol` (#47130)

## What changed

Remove `ultrafast` from the bundled `gpt-5.6-sol` model's `service_tiers`, leaving `priority` (Fast) as its only advertised service tier. Update scenario snapshots for the affected multi-agent tool definitions.

GitOrigin-RevId: 9a235d8f7ea8a72e71152708d2d602194256d420

Preserve foreign working directories in extension tool environments (#47129)

## Why

Extension calls omitted environments whose working directories could not be converted to host-native paths, preventing extensions from receiving those environments.

## What changed

Store `ToolEnvironment.cwd` as `PathUri` and pass all turn environments to extension tools without requiring host-native path conversion. Keep image generation's existing path requirements by selecting the first environment with a convertible working directory when reading referenced images or saving generated images.

GitOrigin-RevId: b4320c6e07d27ef59885cd0013e5d1c535f69659

Add extra policy configuration for Guardian reviews (#47125)

## What changed

- Add `auto_review.extra_policy` and the managed `guardian_extra_policy` requirement to supply policy text alongside the resolved tenant policy. Nonblank managed values take precedence; blank values are ignored.
- Render the additional text through `{{ extra_policy }}` in Guardian reviewer templates and append it to the tenant policy for Guardian v2 classification before truncation.
- Preserve placeholder-like text inside supplied policies literally.

## Testing

Add coverage for configuration precedence, blank values, template substitution, and classifier prompts, plus a scenario verifying that managed tenant and extra policies reach the Guardian reviewer together.

GitOrigin-RevId: 180d8d716c63fe96a92ec5bfbd22db4ddccd4f1f

Increase OpenAI file blob upload timeout from 60 seconds to 5 minutes (#47122)

GitOrigin-RevId: 11069394b3cfe24af4d5efb709ee4f65b88c90de

Pass thread IDs to attachment uploads (#47121)

## Why

Attachment stores need the receiving thread ID to support thread-based placement.

## What changed

Add `thread_id` to `UploadRequest` and pass the session's thread ID through image preparation for messages and tool outputs. Include the ID in debug output while continuing to redact attachment bytes.

## Testing

Extend the image rollout test to assert that a new image uploaded after resume carries the resumed session's thread ID. Update the debug-output test for the new field.

GitOrigin-RevId: f81e3bd761dca704064287177b8ecd7175662f07

Support model-catalog overrides for Code Mode tool messages (#47118)

## What changed

- Add `tools.code_mode` catalog messages for `exec`, `wait`, deferred-tool guidance, and shared MCP TypeScript definitions.
- Render `{{ default_exec_yield_time_ms }}` and `{{ image_helper }}` in `exec` descriptions while preserving runtime tool declarations and the freeform grammar.
- Resolve `wait` descriptions and parameter schemas independently, falling back to bundled parameters for invalid or unsupported schemas.
- Use the active model's Code Mode messages, including after mid-turn model changes. Missing overrides retain bundled defaults; empty text overrides suppress the corresponding text.

## Testing

Add coverage for literal template substitution, runtime section preservation, independent `wait` overrides and fallback behavior, mid-turn model changes, and a yielded cell completing through `wait` with catalog messages.

GitOrigin-RevId: e542a0cd47a7138a414871192cee47790ed1214e

Honor the configured product SKU in remote plugin requests (#47116)

## Why

Remote plugin requests always sent `OAI-Product-Sku: codex`, ignoring the existing `apps_mcp_product_sku` setting.

## What changed

Pass `apps_mcp_product_sku` through plugin configuration and use it for authenticated remote plugin requests, including discovery, search, installation, and sharing. Keep `codex` as the default and include the SKU when comparing remote service configurations.

## Testing

Extend app-server plugin listing and core agent-turn tests to check default and configured SKU headers. Update the CLI worktree test to wait for the user prompt's model request, skipping background title generation requests.

GitOrigin-RevId: 508c9ef9aa3e41b87c92383c3088eb1eb9227fd8

Preserve and expose thread item lifecycle timestamps (#47114)

## What changed

- Persist producer-recorded item start and completion times in thread history, preserving existing non-null values on updates.
- Return nullable `startedAtMs` and `completedAtMs` Unix millisecond timestamps from `thread/items/list`, and update the generated schemas and TypeScript and Python types.
- Leave timestamps unknown for existing rows and older writers.

## Testing

Add coverage for exact timestamp persistence, protocol round trips with present and missing timestamps, paginated item responses, and compatibility with older database writers.

GitOrigin-RevId: 894853481085782ff54db1704799e41446d15e51

Persist thread creator identity in rollouts and SQLite (#47113)

## What changed

- Capture optional `creator_user_id` and `creator_account_id` from authentication when creating a thread, including forks.
- Carry these fields through thread storage, rollout metadata, and a SQLite migration. Leave them absent when unavailable or when reading older threads.
- Preserve recorded creator values across resume and metadata updates. On revert, recover missing rollout values from SQLite before writing replacement metadata.

## Testing

Add coverage for ChatGPT and API-key sessions, resume under another account, forks using current authentication, metadata extraction and upserts, and repeated reverts after creator fields are removed from a rollout.

GitOrigin-RevId: 9839fa42f9392f12226002e2c27d05d5656f5695

Lowercase the retry hint for conversations open in another app (#47112)

Change `R to Retry` to `r to retry` in the TUI notice and update the
corresponding rendering snapshots.

GitOrigin-RevId: f7971ba0f76ac446a5fea53b44390f65aa965be4

Preserve required Windows runtime variables for filesystem helpers (#47108)

## Why

On Windows, MXC needs `SystemDrive` to resolve platform directories and
`LOCALAPPDATA` to create the sandboxed helper process. The helper environment
filter previously dropped both variables.

## What changed

Allow `SystemDrive` and `LOCALAPPDATA` alongside `PATH` in the Windows helper
environment, using case-insensitive name matching.

## Testing

Extend the Windows environment-filtering test to verify that mixed-case runtime
variable names are preserved while `PATH_INJECTION` and `OPENAI_API_KEY` remain
excluded.

GitOrigin-RevId: bab242dd59da59ac6e7f428436e1c139aadadfdd

Preserve originating turn metadata for yielded skill calls (#47106)

## Why

Code Mode callbacks can retain skill tools after another turn becomes active. Looking up the active turn when a delayed skill invocation completes can lose access to the originating turn's metrics and metadata.

## What changed

- Capture and retain the originating `SkillTurnMetrics` when constructing skill analytics.
- Expose turn analytics metadata through the turn extension store and carry it into skill telemetry.
- Add optional turn metadata to `TrackEventsContext` and pass it from app, skill, and plugin usage call sites.

## Testing

Add a regression test that yields a Code Mode cell, starts another turn, and releases both skill reads through a shared barrier. Assert that each `skill_invocation` event retains its originating `turn_id`.

GitOrigin-RevId: aa629dd5f84563d558aa6a86bfbdfc356f1b98e4

Honor configured proxies for realtime WebSocket connections (#47101)

## Why

Realtime WebSockets connected directly, bypassing the configured proxy policy for Voice's WebRTC sideband.

## What changed

Pass the configured `HttpClientFactory` into `RealtimeWebsocketClient` and connect through the shared `WebSocketConnector`. Add support for supplying an existing Rustls configuration to preserve custom CA handling and Windows platform trust.

## Testing

Add an integration test that enables `respect_system_proxy`, starts a WebRTC conversation, and verifies that the sideband establishes its session through an HTTP `CONNECT` proxy and closes successfully.

GitOrigin-RevId: d974c9275d7fe29f388d56a9d5d8ce0c483eb8d0

Preserve assistant answers in bounded TUI task responses (#47100)

## Why

The 999-byte response budget and blanket string truncation could discard assistant answers alongside supporting history. Thread lists could also lose entries when shortened to fit the budget.

## What changed

- Raise the response budget to 8,000 bytes and remove the separate 2,000-character cap on assistant messages in `read_thread` and `wait_threads`.
- Compact oversized read responses around each turn's latest assistant message, and retain every wait target and returned list entry with pagination cursors intact.
- Shorten only content fields when further reduction is needed, preserving valid JSON and protocol values such as IDs, cursors, phases, and statuses. Mark compacted responses and shortened content with `truncated`.
- Request archived thread pages at the requested limit without retrying with smaller pages to meet the response budget.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for oversized wait responses with Unicode and escaped text, list entry and cursor preservation, and an oversized read whose assistant answer survives into the next model request. Extend read and wait tests to verify assistant messages longer than 2,000 characters are retained when they fit.

GitOrigin-RevId: 459fa522d02fbe4cd877b9afe8e66c9358b7bbce

Keep TUI hints immediately above the composer (#47096)

## Why

Activity indicators and queued input previews could separate usage notices and
reading controls from the composer.

## What changed

- Reserve the shared hint row below activity and previews in the owned transcript
  layout, and use its rendered position for hints and reading controls.
- Clip spacing and hints before activity and previews when vertical space is tight.
- Fit usage notice details within half the row, allowing the shortest complete
  warning to use more space on narrow terminals.

## Testing

Expand regression tests and snapshots for running turns, queued inputs, multiline
drafts, short terminals, follow-control clicks, and hidden actionable banners.
Cover five-hour and weekly usage notice width thresholds.

GitOrigin-RevId: e73b3614839ce35c5b0a009901514627a77d4190

Remove the `rust-release-prepare` workflow (#47095)

Delete the workflow that refreshed `codex-rs/models-manager/models.json`
and opened update pull requests every four hours or on manual dispatch.

GitOrigin-RevId: 0179d8af57b17fd69e9b7e94b7f7ed7b0c6dcc24

Restrict Unix local MCP servers to stdio descriptors (#47094)

## Why

Local MCP servers communicate over stdio, so unrelated parent file descriptors should not propagate into the server or its descendants.

## What changed

Apply `DescriptorPolicy::StdioOnly` when launching local stdio MCP servers on Unix, preserving their explicit transport stdio.

## Testing

Add Unix integration tests that check inheritable pipe, socket, and file descriptors are absent from servers and descendants across absolute, relative, and shell-fallback launches. Verify MCP communication, arguments, environment, working directory, parent descriptor ownership, and exec failure reporting remain intact.

GitOrigin-RevId: 37409a5673dbaafa851fd1f78e3a2443eda5f7c6

Centralize JSON-RPC response serialization through payloads (#47089)

## What changed

Serialize `ClientResponse` JSON-RPC results through the untagged
`ClientResponsePayload` enum, and serialize payloads directly instead of matching
on each variant. Preserve existing result shapes and request IDs.

## Testing

Add regression tests covering v1 and v2 payloads with integer and string request
IDs, legacy interrupt responses, and serialization errors from non-UTF-8 paths
on Unix across typed, borrowed, and owned response conversions.

GitOrigin-RevId: d46403b02f910a0d3e41a48a5bc6faa2581873e1

Disable unused default dependency features (#47088)

## What changed

- Disable default features for `sentry`.
- Disable default features for `syntect`, explicitly enable `parsing`, `plist-load`, and `regex-onig`, and switch `two-face` to `syntect-onig` in `codex-rs/tui`.
- Remove the resulting unused dependencies from the Cargo and Bazel lockfiles, including Actix, Sentry integrations, `ureq`, and `yaml-rust`.

GitOrigin-RevId: b3ca6610fdc60ab99909660f56099fbb4093b9c5

Format analytics credit usage with consistent decimal precision (#47086)

## Why

Chat analytics displayed raw credit strings, exposing values such as `0E-10` for plan-covered tasks and unnecessary trailing decimal zeros.

## What changed

Format ordinary credit amounts with two decimal places and thousands separators. Round directly from decimal digits to avoid floating-point rounding errors, so `1.005` becomes `1.01`. Normalize zero to `0.00`, while preserving the original strings for nonzero sub-cent amounts and values outside the safe conversion range.

## Testing

Add assertions for decimal and scientific notation, signed zero, rounding boundaries, tiny adjustments, and large values. Update the chat analytics snapshot to cover a plan-covered task showing `0.00` credits.

GitOrigin-RevId: f946cb408c2c37291447f90de02ebbb557fbc662

Update model catalog descriptions and GPT-5.6-Sol priority (#47085)

## What changed

- Describe GPT-5.6-Sol as a reliable agentic workhorse for everyday tasks and change its catalog `priority` from `6` to `4`.
- Describe GPT-5.5 as a proven previous-generation model for coding and general work.
- Refresh model picker, migration prompt, and agent tool snapshots to reflect the catalog updates.

GitOrigin-RevId: b39f51c22862b8cef585ed76f3973c9f4b670c27

Avoid building a host SQLite driver for SQLx macros (#47084)

## Why

Row derives and migration embedding do not need query macros or a host SQLite driver.

## What changed

- Remove the `macros` feature from `sqlx` and depend directly on `sqlx-macros` with only `derive` and `migrate` enabled.
- Update state and thread-store derives and migration embedding to use `sqlx_macros`.
- Enable `sqlx-sqlite`'s `offline` feature directly to preserve query-description support in the target driver.
- Pin `sqlx`, `sqlx-macros`, and `sqlx-sqlite` to `=0.9.0` to keep their versions aligned.

GitOrigin-RevId: 8a8ef691ff2862a7dad978a578c5206b52dfc0b6

Extract per-thread enrichment into a dedicated async helper (#47083)

Move status resolution, live settings, and subagent input eligibility into
`enrich_loaded_thread`. Keep `enrich_loaded_threads` responsible for fetching
watched statuses and enriching threads concurrently with `join_all`, preserving
existing behavior.

GitOrigin-RevId: 54f7b61b7cc6dcdfb4a63c1906080858b18df378

Show the voice toggle in the TUI shortcut overlay (#47082)

## What changed

Add a Voice entry using the configured `toggle_voice` binding (`F8` by default). Show it only when voice commands are enabled and no side conversation is active.

## Testing

Update footer and shortcut overlay snapshots to include the Voice entry.

GitOrigin-RevId: ba92f5af1ce1a06d9700d31dcc90e5acb1613803

Track cumulative MCP attribution across requests and thread history (#47081)

## What changed

- Record each MCP source and its first turn, including connector and plugin identifiers when available. Cover direct and Code Mode calls, including returned errors and results that are not printed.
- Persist cumulative attribution checkpoints and restore them across compaction, resume, and forks, including forks limited to recent turns.
- Attach fresh attribution to Responses API `client_metadata` under `mcp_attribution`, outside model-visible content. Restrict transmission to allowed OpenAI HTTPS destinations for both HTTP and WebSocket requests.
- Report `attribution_error` for legacy history without checkpoints, malformed or conflicting attribution, and serialized attribution exceeding 16 KiB.

## Testing

Add coverage for source deduplication, checkpoint persistence and restoration, recent-turn forks, direct and Code Mode calls, destination filtering, and the serialized size limit.

GitOrigin-RevId: fd285e152ca9e24bfa000debb20013709d67a86e

Mask daemon socket paths exposed through ancestor bind mounts (#47079)

## Why

The Linux sandbox rejected bind mounts of ancestors of the app-server socket directory, even when the exposed socket paths could be masked. This prevented sandbox startup with otherwise usable temporary-directory mount layouts.

## What changed

- Collect the socket directory and its exposed ancestor-mount aliases, then mask each path after filesystem binds, including read-only subpaths and the synthetic-mount registry.
- Continue rejecting direct directory or socket aliases and nested mounts that cannot preserve socket isolation.
- Reject non-UTF-8 mask destinations to avoid masking a different path through lossy conversion.

## Testing

Extend mount-analysis tests for ancestor aliases, private temporary directories, and WSLg masks. Extend socket-isolation coverage to verify that ancestor and registry aliases hide daemon sockets while unrelated sockets remain reachable. Add a regression test for non-UTF-8 mask paths.

GitOrigin-RevId: 49a9a764fbe1fddacd99c3a78099fbffff53b944

Serialize environment updates and cancel removed pending attachments (#47077)

## Why

Concurrent credential refreshes could restore a removed environment by overwriting the selection list with stale state. Unpolled snapshot futures could also keep pending configuration alive after an environment was removed.

## What changed

- Protect environment selections with a mutex and update them in place to serialize selection changes, configuration refreshes, and connection listener setup.
- Capture only selection metadata and resolution futures in snapshots so they do not retain pending configuration senders.

## Testing

Add regression tests for removal during credential refresh and cancellation while an unpolled snapshot is held. Strengthen the pending attachment integration test to check that `wait_for_environment` returns the expected environment ID and `ready` status.

GitOrigin-RevId: c6f933e8d3031b05335ddcfed00ab400aa5bad2a

Include attributed previews in agent message board notifications (#47075)

## Why

Message board notifications exposed only post and thread IDs, requiring a read to see any post content.

## What changed

Deliver notifications as `agent_message` items with author and recipient attribution. Include a `CHANNEL_POST` payload with the sender, channel, message and thread IDs, and up to 150 characters of post text. Direct agents to `read_post` when the preview is truncated, and retain recognition of legacy user-role notices.

## Testing

Update the model-context scenario to assert the notification's author, recipient, and preview payload, and update the idle-agent scenario to check for the new notification format.

GitOrigin-RevId: e0e2794be82e38bba47f41fb4fc8128eb5e47619

Refresh host-supplied cloud skills at turn startup (#47074)

## What changed

- Replace the built-in orchestrator skill provider with a host-supplied cloud provider, using `cloud` authority and `c` root aliases in skill tools and prompts.
- Add `cloud.skills.enabled`, defaulting to true but requiring a supplied provider. Keep `orchestrator.skills` accepted as a legacy no-op setting, and remove the app server's automatic orchestrator provider registration.
- Discover cloud skills once per turn during cancellable startup. Serve catalog snapshots to prompts and tools without triggering discovery or retries.
- Scope cached catalogs and resources to authentication state. Preserve them on refresh failures within the same scope, invalidate them when that scope changes, and reject late discovery or read results from replaced cache generations.
- Reuse executor discovery catalogs only when successful discovery inputs and bundled-skill settings match.

## Testing

Add coverage for per-turn refresh, skill removal, same-account failures and reconnects, authentication changes, and stale in-flight results. Update configuration and tool tests for cloud authority, provider gating, and resource reads without an executor.

GitOrigin-RevId: c57e38ec7dcc880c0d4c8a2995adfd3e28301079

Wait for thread idle in Guardian context budget tests (#47073)

## Why

`TurnComplete` precedes active-turn cleanup, so injecting follow-up history immediately afterward can race with cleanup.

## What changed

Register the `ThreadIdle` lifecycle contributor in `review_preserves_user_instructions_until_request_budgeting` and wait for the thread to become idle after the initial and follow-up turns.

GitOrigin-RevId: 1ae6c80593a71d331c5c6ddf85bbe10822a68afe

Highlight selected newlines in the transcript view (#47068)

## Why

Transcript selections could include a newline without showing it in the highlight, making `code` and `code\n` look identical.

## What changed

Highlight one trailing cell for selected hard line breaks when space permits, including newline separators between transcript entries. Track logical line endings so soft wraps and synthetic rows do not receive newline highlights.

## Testing

Add selection snapshots for hard breaks within and between entries, plus layout coverage for empty lines, wrapping, trailing whitespace, and synthetic rows. Update the app selection test to assert the leading newline highlight.

GitOrigin-RevId: d6f332c472598a3f79557b7ebb41730c6acc7820

Deduplicate deprecation notices in the TUI transcript (#47065)

## Why

Global deprecation notices can be delivered again by hidden threads, creating duplicate transcript entries.

## What changed

Skip incoming deprecation notices whose summary and details match a notice already in retained history. Preserve notices with different summaries or details, and allow notices to appear again after clearing history or rebuilding the transcript during a thread switch.

## Testing

Add a regression test and transcript snapshot covering repeated live and replayed notifications, an open transcript overlay, distinct notice content, and delivery after clearing history or switching threads.

GitOrigin-RevId: 9c0512f588dfb54f7934380119211b57b0df0ee4

Stop redundant message-board reads when limits reach one (#47064)

## Why

When result metadata exceeds the output budget, message-board tools keep retrying identical reads after all limits reach one.

## What changed

Stop shrinking reads once every page and character limit reaches one, returning the existing metadata-budget error if the result still does not fit. Use the largest effective limit to keep retrying while either the page size or preview length can still shrink.

## Testing

Add regression assertions for all five read tools with an impossible output budget, checking the error and exact read counts. Cover unequal page and preview limits and limits that are not powers of two.

GitOrigin-RevId: f00ddbcf0372c8f9318fa178259868caae55e68b

Add a partial index for agent message board root posts (#47063)

Create `posts_roots_created` on `(board, channel, timestamp, seq)` for
posts where `id = root` in the local SQLite schema.

GitOrigin-RevId: 4c40e0d853deaa3ab6b6303525870e3b7bfc3b14

Fetch local message board thread summaries in one query (#47055)

## Why

Listing threads issued two additional SQL queries per root to fetch its reply count and latest reply.

## What changed

Fetch roots, reply counts, and latest replies in a single query. Materialize the selected page before looking up reply summaries, preserving creation and activity ordering, pagination, and preview limits.

## Testing

Strengthen pagination assertions to check complete thread summaries for threads without replies, including Unicode preview truncation, reply counts, and last activity timestamps.

GitOrigin-RevId: cbbed36418a349a18daf0771f4ed27aa47de0bc1

Batch message-board subscriber reads into one SQLite result (#47050)

## Why

Posting to the local agent message board fetched each subscriber row across SQLite's worker thread while holding a write transaction.

## What changed

Use `json_group_array(agent)` to fetch subscribers as a single JSON array, then deserialize it before collecting notification recipients.

## Testing

Extend the local board test to verify that posting to a channel with no subscribers succeeds without sending notifications.

GitOrigin-RevId: ad294e19c78ee501f1de2084f7c02fa96f53418d

Share SQLite pools across local agent message-board handles (#47049)

## Why

Opening each local message-board handle created a separate SQLite pool for the same database.

## What changed

- Cache one shared pool per canonical database path within the process, using weak references so the last handle can release it.
- Serialize pool initialization with deletion and corruption recovery. Close and evict the cached pool before replacing a corrupt database, and block new handles until deletion tombstones are saved.

## Testing

Enable library unit tests and add coverage for concurrent handles sharing a pool, releasing it after the last handle drops, and creating a new pool on reopen.

GitOrigin-RevId: 4d4a5c9ea9f063733df85a2ac120d51099736520

Recover corrupt message-board storage during thread deletion (#47042)

## Why

A corrupt agent message-board database can block thread deletion even when the feature is disabled.

## What changed

When corruption prevents opening the database for board deletion, back it up and recreate it before recording deletion tombstones. Recovery resets all boards, retaining their previous storage in the backup. Other database open failures continue to return an error without deleting the thread or replacing storage.

## Testing

Add an app-server regression test with the feature disabled that verifies ordinary open failures preserve storage and the thread, while corruption recovery preserves the backup, deletes the requested thread, retains another thread, and records the board tombstone in the recreated database.

GitOrigin-RevId: 85f7d6303ae5c359782018cad4a78461d86c43db

Preserve delivered messages through post-tool hook failures (#47039)

## Why

Guardian can lose a confirmed User Messaging message from its parent context when a `PostToolUse` hook blocks the result or is cancelled. The message has already been sent and remains relevant to interpreting the user's authorization.

## What changed

Capture confirmed message text after input-rewriting hooks in shared per-call state before awaiting post-tool processing. Attach that evidence to the response metadata even when dispatch returns a blocked or aborted result, while keeping post-tool hooks cancellable. Calls cancelled before delivery confirmation contribute no message evidence.

## Testing

Extend Guardian subagent authorization coverage to verify retained messages after post-tool hook blocking and cancellation, and their absence when cancellation precedes delivery confirmation.

GitOrigin-RevId: 9abb7959980eada20d0fb5c0b3a4a8669e4cd0a3

Cache OS discovery for user agents and telemetry (#47038)

## Why

OS discovery can launch subprocesses on Linux. Repeating it for requests, analytics events, and metrics provider creation adds unnecessary work for stable metadata.

## What changed

Cache `os_info::get()` with a separate `LazyLock` in user-agent generation, analytics runtime metadata, and metrics OS resource attributes. Continue reading the user-agent originator and suffix on each call so updates remain effective.

## Testing

Add an isolated Linux regression test that races initial user-agent lookups and repeats calls, verifies `lsb_release` and `getconf` each run once, and checks that subsequent originator and suffix updates appear in the user agent.

GitOrigin-RevId: 337e45ff88b863d2a4aa387a8e7d2e291c045906

Share stored JSON payloads across code mode cells with `Arc` (#47036)

## Why

Creating a cell deep-copies every stored JSON value, including values the cell never loads. Storing a value also duplicates its payload between the cell's local state and pending writes.

## What changed

Use `Arc<JsonValue>` throughout the session store, cell runtime, and completion writes to share immutable payloads. Keep a separate map snapshot for each cell so later commits cannot change its view of stored values.

GitOrigin-RevId: 4535f0f2ed0c8f8cbfb8d24cf1cb44cbc74472b5

Defer extension tool history materialization until first access (#47035)

## Why

Extension tool calls eagerly copied and converted conversation history even when the tool never read it.

## What changed

Retain a shared invocation-time snapshot and defer conversion to raw response items until `ConversationHistory::items()` is called. Cache the result across clones with `LazyLock`, and keep debug formatting from triggering materialization. Release unrelated history metadata when capturing the shared items.

## Testing

Extend the extension executor test to verify that history first read after a later turn still reflects the invocation-time snapshot, in both legacy and paginated history modes. Update the history API test to check that shared items preserve their envelopes.

GitOrigin-RevId: c737b765b7e4889735dc78e12d685d36e854570b

Preserve ordered assistant context in Guardian reviews (#47030)

## Why

Guardian's retained root context appended assistant messages after user evidence and omitted questions sent through User Messaging. This could leave subagent authorization reviews with missing or misplaced conversational context.

## What changed

- Record assistant messages and function calls in the same order sequence as accepted user inputs, then merge retained review context by recorded position while prioritizing user evidence within the message budget.
- Capture bounded User Messaging text after input hooks when a send succeeds, and match it to the original call for assistant context.
- Label assistant context without a recorded position explicitly and clear parent assistant and tool positions when forking agent history.
